issues.description: Several specific technical claims (e.g. 'retriever returns links + krátké úryvky', 'generativní model vrátí odpověď spolu s referencemi na zdroje') are plausible but not explicitly backed by the provided RETRIEVED EXCERPTS. The outline/context does include RAG blueprint and mentions indexation/metadata and audit logs, but the section should add explicit cross‑references to those parts (8.3, 8.5 / 9.4.1) to satisfy the non‑trivial grounding rule.
issues.required_fix: Add explicit citations / cross‑references to the RAG blueprint and security/audit sections (e.g. 9.4.1 and 8.3 / 8.8) for statements about returned references, audit logging and orchestration responsibilities; or rephrase those sentences as 'recommended behaviour' and label them as general background knowledge (if no direct citation available).

issues.description: Terminology should be consistent with the rest of the manual (e.g. the outline uses 'uložiště' / 'indexace, verze dokumentů, metadata'). The section uses 'Uložistě' (typo) in a couple of places.
issues.required_fix: Fix typos and align terms: change 'Uložistě' -> 'Uložiště' and ensure 'indexace', 'verzování' and 'metadata' use the same Czech forms as in other sections.

issues.description: LaTeX is generally correct, but the use of \vspace inside a flow of short paragraphs and repeated \noindent lines is stylistic and may conflict with document class formatting. Also ensure footnotes in itemize render as intended in the target class.
issues.required_fix: Either keep current simple formatting or replace repeated \noindent+\vspace with section/subsection/paragraph commands consistent with the main document style. Verify footnotes inside itemize render correctly; if not, move the \footnote to end of item text or use \footnotemark/\footnotetext pair.

issues.description: The 'Zjednodušený datový tok' is concise but omits an explicit PII / redaction step and human‑in‑the‑loop verification steps which are recommended elsewhere in the manual (DPIA / audit checklist).
issues.required_fix: Add a step after indexation describing sanitization/pseudonymization of PII (or a check for it) and explicitly state that model outputs must be human‑verified before use in assessment contexts; reference the DPIA / checklist sections (Vzorné DPIA and 9.4.2).

issues.description: Practical integration bullets reference appropriate KB items (OneDrive/Office365, Pokrok v matematice, Minecraft Education), but the section would benefit from a short concrete example (teacher workflow or sample prompt/policy) to help practitioners translate architecture into classroom practice.
issues.required_fix: Add one short, concrete example: e.g. teacher indexes a lecture PDF in LMS → how a typical query from a student flows through the retriever → sample augmented prompt (high level) → how teacher verifies and records references (linking this to the students' required declaration templates).

suggested_edits.edit_instruction: Correct spelling to 'Uložiště znalostí' and add a short parenthetical citation pointer to the RAG blueprint (9.4.1) indicating support for versioning and metadata fields.

Either cite the RAG blueprint for the behaviour (retriever returning relevant passages and source links) or rephrase to 'typicky retriever vybere relevantní pasáže a identifikátory zdrojů (doporučeno: vracet krátké úryvky pro kontext a odkaz na dokument) — viz RAG blueprint 9.4.1 / 8.5.'

Insert an additional step between (1) and (2) or after (1): 'Po indexaci: provést kontrolu a redakci PII (pseudonymizace/anonimizace) v uložených metadatech a dokumentech; záznamy o provedených úpravách se uchovají v auditní stopě.' Reference the DPIA checklist (Vzorné DPIA) and privacy checklist (9.4.2). Also append to step (4): 'Výstupy modelu by měly obsahovat referenční odkazy a být potvrzeny lidským ověřením; orchestrátor uchovává auditní záznam dotazu, použitých zdrojů a verze indexu.'

Add one concrete mini‑example (2–3 short sentences) showing how a teacher would add a lecture PDF to the LMS, mark it for indexing, and use the RAG assistant to generate study questions — include a brief note to check generated content and retain references (link to 'Pokrok v matematice' / Microsoft tools where relevant).

Add explicit pointers to existing sections: 'Pro DPA/DPIA viz Vzorné DPIA (sekce 9.3.3 / kapitola 8.2–8.3). Omezte ukládání PII (viz checklist 9.4.2), používejte lidské ověření výsledků a nastavte auditní logy (viz 8.3).'
